# Color Chime

> Color Chime is a free, colorful visual timer for kids, made for parents and teachers. You pick a time, a color, and a sound. A colored dial shrinks as time runs out, so children who can't read a clock yet can see how much time is left, and a chime plays when time is up.

It runs in any web browser at https://colorchime.com, on phones, tablets, computers, and classroom screens. There's nothing to install, no account, and no ads. On a phone or tablet it can be added to the home screen and opened like an app.

## What it does

- Set any time in hours, minutes, and seconds, or tap a favorite such as 1, 2, 5, 10, or 30 minutes. Favorites can be added and removed.
- Choose from 20 colors for the dial or make a custom one, or pick several colors at once, which split the dial into rings.
- Choose the sound for when time is up: bell, bird, guitar, watch, or silent.
- Pause, resume, and reset at any time. The time left also shows in the browser tab.
- An optional setting keeps the screen on while the timer runs.
- A history shows timers that were run before.
- Follows the device's light or dark mode.

## Good for

- Routines with young children (about ages 2 to 10): tidying up, brushing teeth, getting dressed, bedtime, screen time, taking turns.
- Classrooms: transitions, centers, tests, and clean-up, shown on a projector or smart board.
- Anyone who finds it easier to see time pass than to read numbers.

## Privacy

Color Chime has no accounts and no ads. Settings, favorites, and history are saved only in the browser on the device being used. The site counts visits anonymously, without cookies.

## Links

- [Color Chime](https://colorchime.com): open the timer
